thread:
incidents-bot: PAGED: High error rate + QPS spike for org GreenHarbor detected by org-qos-alert (threshold breached: 4.5% 5m errors). Pager routed to oncall-l2

oncall-l2: I'm on it, picking up the page. can someone post recent org traffic numbers?

alex.dev: greenharbor org_id=org_gh_42, rolling 1m QPS jumped from ~220 -> ~3400 at ~00:03 UTC, 4xx ratio 5.2%, 500s ~0.6% (orig spike looks request-volume, not model failure)

celeste_sre: seeing many short requests with small prompt sizes — likely a client-side retry storm or runaway A/B test. top routes: /v1/chat/completions (72%), /v1/embeddings (18%).

raj_ops: adding throttle analysis. current per-org RL policy: 800 r/s token-limit. greenharbor currently hitting ~950 r/s. They exceeded quota and requests backed up -> upstream queueing -> elevated 4xx/5xx latency.

emily-cs: I've opened support ticket with GreenHarbor (CS-4231) and pinged their infra lead @sarah-eng. they confirm they rolled a new 'fast-feeds' variant of their feed service at 23:58 UTC.

sarah-eng: yes that's us. our A/B 50% -> 100% rollout had a bug that caused clients to loop on retry. we're pausing the rollout but need urgent relief while we rollback.

oncall-l2: ok mitigation plan proposal: 1) emergency temporary org-level QPS bump + short token cap increase so client can drain; 2) disable embeddings route for the org as it's noisy; 3) ask GH to rollback. need approvals for org override.

ben-pm: thumbs up from product for emergency override, provide rollback window and exact commands used. patch must be logged. :thumbsup:

raj_ops: executing emergency adjustments now. running admin commands:```bash
# bump qps to 3500 for greenharbor
redwoodctl org update-quota --org org_gh_42 --qps 3500 --note "Emergency: customer rollback in progress - pager 2139991111"
# disable embeddings route for org
redwoodctl org feature-flag set --org org_gh_42 --flag embeddings --state off --note "Mitigate noisy route"
```

incidents-bot: ACTION LOG: quota_update user=raj_ops org=org_gh_42 new_qps=3500 at 2139991280

alex.dev: routing change propagated to edge proxies (edge-1..4). watching metrics.

celeste_sre: within 45s we see QPS drop on downstream queueing and 4xx start to fall. 1m error rate down to 1.8%, 5m trending down. 99p latency from 2.3s -> 1.1s.

oncall-l2: note — we also applied a short token cap increment (tokens/sec) to avoid client thrash while they drain. logged: redwoodctl org update-quota --org org_gh_42 --tokens-per-min 150000

raj_ops: I also applied a temporary traffic-shaper rule to deprioritize low-tier traffic on the busy backends so overall SLOs stay healthy:```json
{"matcher":"org!=org_gh_42","priority":"normal"}
```

emily-cs: GreenHarbor status update sent to customer: "We applied an emergency throttle adjustment and disabled the embeddings endpoint for your org to keep your rollout from impacting other customers. Please rollback the client change and confirm."

sarah-eng: rollback started at 00:08 UTC, pausing new client traffic. ETA to complete 2-3 min.

celeste_sre: monitoring: by 00:11 UTC error rate back to 0.4%, QPS normalized ~240, latency stable.

oncall-l2: great. we should gradually revert the emergency changes once GH confirms stable. propose 10min stable window. any objections?

ben-pm: no objections. capture timeline and follow-up action items. I want a short customer-facing summary after we close.

raj_ops: initiating revert commands:```bash
# re-enable embeddings route
redwoodctl org feature-flag set --org org_gh_42 --flag embeddings --state on --note "Revert after emergency mitigation"
# restore qps to committed level
redwoodctl org update-quota --org org_gh_42 --qps 800 --note "Restore post-mitigation"
```

incidents-bot: ACTION LOG: featureflag_update user=raj_ops org=org_gh_42 embeddings=on at 2139991565

alex.dev: all revert ops applied. confirming proxies removed temporary rules.

celeste_sre: final checks: 1m/5m error rates steady <0.5%, no residual queueing, no cross-org impact observed.

emily-cs: sent final note to GH: "Your rollback completed; we restored normal quotas and re-enabled embeddings. Please confirm and let us know if you'd like help running a safe canary."

sarah-eng: confirmed. we'll do staged rollout and add better client-side backoff. thanks for fast help.

oncall-l2: marking incident resolved and handing to postmortem owner: ben-pm. please capture root cause: missing client backoff + ramped A/B test. follow-ups: (1) org-level emergency override runbook update, (2) automatic embeddings disable when embeddings QPS spike > X, (3) customer education doc on safe rollouts.

ben-pm: assigned postmortem PR: PM-3422. Timeline and logs attached to ticket. closing incident in 10m unless new alerts. :white_check_mark:

incidents-bot: RESOLVED: GreenHarbor emergency RL bump resolved. duration 00:22. incident-2139991111 closed.
